text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Yukino Bijin, what a run, as 
expected! She really proved her strength 
during the Classic tier, too.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Good work out there! That was a great race 
to watch~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm gettin' cheered on! Though it ain't 
like they're goin' wild or anything.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I still haven't truly... grabbed hold of 
everyone's hearts."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Aagh, this is so hard!? How are ya even 
supposed to know if you've captured 
someone's heart anyway!?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I've really gone and made one crazy 
resolution, haven't I?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is fine! You don't gotta see 
results right away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Didn't Grandma use to say it back in the 
day? 'Life is long; if ya rush, ya lose.')

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! I can still keep running!
WOOOOOOOOO~! Yukino~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uhyaah!? Wh-What was that...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villager A
text_block_list.text: Yukino-chaaan! You were truly amazin'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villager B
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO~N! That tiny little girl is now...! 
It's the best! Come on, everyone make some 
more noise!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villagers
text_block_list.text: Yukinoooo! You did itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Banner
text_block_list.text:
"‘Star of Morioka, Yukino Bijin: Do your 
best!’"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aya!? If it ain't everyone from the 
village!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Why... Wait, did you seriously come all 
the way to Kansai!? From Morioka!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villager C
text_block_list.text:
If it's for Yukino-chan, I'd go north, 
south, east, or west, anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villager D
text_block_list.text:
Your Trainer contacted us! They said 
Yukino's facing a real clutch moment right 
now, so we just had to come cheer you on 
in person!

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fellow Villager E
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan~! We've always got your back~! 
Don't lose to yourself~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ye kindly. Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I won't lose to myself! I'll grit my 
teeth, dig deep, and give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: "...Which one of us is the sparkly one?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha... I believe in you. I believe 
in you, but... if you really can't take it 
anymore—"

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I... still have to keep running. 
Because I want to believe in myself just a 
little bit more—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Everyone from the village came to 
see meee!

While giving her parents my routine 
updates, I had mentioned how hard she was 
currently working. I never imagined they 
would rush all the way here in person...
choice_data_list: Everyone really cares about you, Yukino.
Everyone really cares about you, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, it tickles a bit, but I'm really 
grateful.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone's faces gave me a huge 
boost of energy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel like I can definitely work 
even harder!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's do our best again next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I... in order to shine bright, I want to 
challenge a lot more GⅠs!

Yukino Bijin's face was full of 
confidence. She was no longer the girl who 
had shown such hesitation back at the 
Hanshin JF.

A race that Umamusume who excelled on the 
Triple Tiara route often aim for. Those 
running in it are the sparkling Umamusume 
she spoke of.
choice_data_list:
Maybe you can polish your skills even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Maybe I really can run super 
cool now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Victoria Mile!

And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Victoria Mile.
